chunks: From him, from Ibn Fazzal who said:
I heard Abu Al-Hassan (peace be upon him) saying: 'No two parties ever met (in a confrontation) at all, except victory was for the one who was greater of the two in pardoning'.
ai.seo_question: What determines victory in a conflict between two parties according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) establishes a divine principle that victory in conflict is not determined by military strength but by spiritual magnanimity (*afwan*). This teaching underscores the Shia emphasis on *akhlaq* (character) as a decisive factor in worldly and otherworldly success, encouraging believers to prioritize forgiveness over retaliation. It serves as a practical guide for resolving disputes, suggesting that mercy attracts divine support (*nasr*).
